InventoryValuation.title: Inventory Valuation
InventoryValuation.description: Per-item, per-warehouse inventory valuation snapshot. Stores the current cost basis under FIFO or moving-average method. Updated on every StockMovement event; drives COGS posting to the shillinq GL. Formalises the ADR-000 InventoryValuation entity in the shillinq register.

quantity.description: Quantity of items currently on hand for this product+warehouse combination.

unitCost.description: Cost per unit under the selected valuation method. FIFO: weighted average of remaining open lots. Moving-average: running weighted average. Stored to 4 decimal places.

totalValue.description: Total inventory value (quantity × unitCost). Rounded to 2 decimal places.

valuationMethod.description: Costing method applied to this item-warehouse pair.

date.description: Date of the valuation snapshot or last update.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this valuation record.

pendingCogs.description: Set to true when a COGS posting could not be completed because GL accounts are not configured. Cleared when the posting is successfully retried.

lastProcessedMovementUuid.description: UUID of the last StockMovement processed by the valuation engine. Used for idempotency on retry.

active.label: Active
active.description: Current in-use valuation snapshot; updated on every stock movement.

adjusted.label: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Manual correction applied, or COGS posting pending due to missing GL config. Remains active for stock tracking purposes.

obsolete.label: Obsolete
obsolete.description: Item discontinued or moved out; historical only. No new movements accepted.

adjust.label: Mark as adjusted
adjust.description: Apply a manual quantity correction or flag a pending COGS posting.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive
archiveFromActive.description: Discontinue item. Blocked when on-hand quantity is non-zero.

archiveFromAdjusted.label: Archive
archiveFromAdjusted.description: Discontinue item from adjusted state. Blocked when on-hand quantity is non-zero.

methodChange.label: Change valuation method
methodChange.description: Switch between FIFO and moving-average. Blocked when on-hand quantity is non-zero to prevent cost distortion.

product.description: The Product this valuation record tracks.

costCenter.description: The CostCenter dimension for this valuation.

activeValuation.message: duplicate active valuation: an active InventoryValuation already exists for this product+warehouse combination.
